Crl.P.No.9783 of 2024  Heard learned counsel for the  petitioner.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor  takes notice on behalf of respondent/State and seeks time for getting instructions.
The matter relates to the Tobacco Products and the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner,
there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings in S.C.No.310 of 2019 on the file of the Court of Senior Civil Judge at Badvel, YSR Kadapa District for a period of eight (08) weeks.
